semantics.business_validation: Driver must compare frozen world, RNG and semantic event output against the plain same-input run.
semantics.denominator: Externally measured full ordinary Simulation.step elapsed, including its pending wait loop.
semantics.nested_calls: Inclusive and exclusive selected dynamic calls; exclusive subtracts timed descendants. Never add inclusive rows or add nested rows to root rows.
semantics.observer_handler_us: Measured handler bodies only; wrapper dispatch and timer read overhead are not fully isolatable. Quantify total perturbation against a paired plain same-input window.
semantics.residual_us: Full step minus root spans and observed handlers: outer step setup, pending sleeps, call/return gaps and timer precision.
semantics.root_stages: Disjoint spans in the original step_nonblocking phase order; observed handler time removed.

public360.percentile_selection_policy: Nearest rank on this window current plain samples, sorted by (elapsed_us,index); corresponding root record uses identical index/tick. Root percentiles are not substituted. Duplicate selected indices share labels.

focused_observer_perturbation.call_count_note: Absent aggregate row means no recorded call across the complete wrapped window; no missing function time is invented. Counts are diagnostic observations.

public360.interpretation: All modes execute identical production business logic and input. Differences between these sequential same-source runs combine observer perturbation and run variation. A root run faster than plain is not negative observer overhead. No isolated algorithm speedup or corrected plain CPU is inferred.

focused_selection.interpretation: This actual selection contains 14 methods. An entry-count limit such as 16 does not bound dynamic wrapper calls, marshalling cost or perturbation and is not a real CPU budget.

limits: Focused function and stage times are not adopted as production CPU costs.
Root stage times are observations in root instrumentation, not exact plain CPU.
Sequential same-source root/plain differences include run variation; negative differences are not negative observer overhead.
Do not subtract measured observer handlers from a nested run to reconstruct plain CPU.
Do not add inclusive nested rows to each other or to root stages.
Each fixed-input window retains its own percentiles; no pooling or cropping.
No engine, build, packaging, source edits or game tests were performed by this summary.

new_file_inventory.scope: Current cache top-level evidence and generated profiler source snapshots only; copied full engine/import/assets/project trees are not enumerated or claimed as new production files.
new_file_inventory.unmeasured_followup_note: Inventory only. Follow-up bookend preparations have no result included in this six-window summary.
